Java attaches only the immediately preceding block to a declaration, so the old block became a dead comment floating before `validateEdge`'s own doc, and `buildAdjacencyList` was left with no documentation at all. The orphan is now removed and `buildAdjacencyList` has its Javadoc restored.

**`main` counter pattern simplified** — the `total++; if (check(...)) passed++;` idiom repeated ten times was unusual and made each test line harder to read. Collecting all results into a `boolean[]` first and then counting in a loop separates the "run tests" step from the "tally results" step cleanly. It also makes `results.length` the source of truth for total, so the count can never drift out of sync with the actual number of calls.
